name: Adafruit ESP32 Feather V2 (8 MB flash, 2 MB PSRAM)
description: Classic dual-core ESP32 (PICO-MINI-02 module) Feather with Wi-Fi 4 + Bluetooth Classic/LE, 8 MB flash, 2 MB PSRAM, USB-C, LiPo charger and STEMMA QT.
notes: USB-UART bridge (CP2102N), not native USB; the original ESP32 has no USB OTG/UF2.
A2, A3, A4 and D37 (GPIO34/39/36/37) are input-only; ADC2 pins cannot be used while Wi-Fi is active.
Sold in PCB-antenna, w.FL-antenna and assembled-header versions.
User button on GPIO38; NeoPixel and STEMMA QT power switchable via GPIO2.
